116c7db8364deaa1.description: Job description Stage -Modélisation mécanique des effets de recouvrement et surépaisseurs de matériau composite oxyd F/H Stage 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet L'utilisation des matériaux composites dans l'aéronautique civile contribue à améliorer les performances des moteurs d'avions. Leurs caractéristiques mécaniques couplées à leur légèreté ont permis aux matériaux composites à matrice organique (CMO) de substituer les solutions métalliques dans les zones froides du moteur. Les composites à matrice céramique (CMC) ont, de plus, d'excellentes propriétés thermomécaniques et thermiques qui garantissent leurs capacités de fonctionnement à des températures extrêmes. Leur utilisation dans les zones chaudes des moteurs permettrait d'augmenter significativement leur température d'utilisation, et donc, leur rendement. C'est dans ce contexte industriel que Safran CERAMICS développe de nouveaux matériaux CMC ainsi que les pièces associées. La mission sera de travailler sur l'effet de recouvrement et des surépaisseurs nécessaires au drapage des CMCs sur le comportement matériau et lien avec les calculs de justification. L'objectif de ce travail sera double : - Suivre & Réaliser des essais matériaux standards sur éprouvettes taillées dans une plaque avec des recouvrements et des surépaisseurs - Comparer le comportement observé vis-à-vis des modélisations éléments finis classiquement faites en justification au bureau d'étude - Proposer ou explorer des pistes d'amélioration ou des pistes de modification des critères de justification Une première partie consistera à récupérer l'état de l'art issu des composites à matrice organique (CMO) ou céramique (CMC) des sociétés Safran et de la littérature scientifique, et à positionner la problématique vis-à-vis des applications en cours d'étude chez Safran Ceramics, ainsi que synthétiser les différentes approches trouvées dans la bibliographie. Cette étude bibliographique pourra être menée en parallèle de la mise en place et la réalisation des essais sur éprouvettes sur nos machines d'essai à Safran Ceramics Dans un second temps, les résultats issus des essais devront être confrontés aux modélisations classiques alimentant la justification au sein du bureau d'étude. Les écarts observés devront être documentés et des pistes ou hypothèses d'amélioration de la justification ou de recommandations quant aux positionnement ou orientations des recouvrements/surépaisseurs seront proposées Enfin, une ou plusieurs pistes proposées pourront être explorées par vous afin d'améliorer la prise en compte de ces contraintes de fabrication dans le cadre de la justification des pièces CMC. Vous devrez faire preuve d'esprit de synthèse, de vision transverse, et s'adapter à l'environnement d'entreprise SAFRAN. Modélisation Corrélation essais calculs Vous êtes en formation en mécanique, modélisation des structures (éléments finis), connaissance des matériaux composite appréciée Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

Conduct site inspections for earthworks, subgrade, asphalt works, concrete works, pipelines, manholes, culverts, and drainage structures. Verify materials delivered to site and ensure compliance with approved material submittals. Review and witness testing activities including compaction tests, concrete testing, asphalt testing, and other QA/QC requirements. 1141cb439fc49c18.description: About the Role Thndr is seeking a Head of Brokerage to establish and manage its brokerage operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience who will be registered with the Capital Market Authority (CMA) as a senior executive for Thndr KSA. Key Responsibilities Design and lead Thndr’s core brokerage function in KSA, covering client onboarding, order execution, and settlement. Establish dealing and order-handling processes compliant with CMA conduct-of-business and best-execution requirements. Oversee day-to-day brokerage operations and address operational issues promptly. Collaborate with the compliance team on trade surveillance, market-conduct controls, and client protection. Manage the relationship with the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul) and support the relationship with the CMA. Gather and implement insights for innovative brokerage solutions in the Saudi market. Analyze market practices and regulations and their impact on Thndr. Work with Thndr’s leadership to develop and execute the brokerage strategy for KSA. Partner with the product team to enhance brokerage services and client experience. Manage the brokerage budget and business plan. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8 years of experience in securities brokerage, with at least 5 years in KSA at a CMA-licensed brokerage or Tadawul member firm. At least 3 years in a senior or team-leading role within the brokerage value chain. Working knowledge of the Saudi brokerage ecosystem, including order submission, clearing, and settlement. CMA Qualifications and Registration Successful completion of the CMA’s securities brokers qualification route: CME-3A and CME-3B, or an exemption granted by the CMA. About Thndr Thndr aims to democratize investing, providing easy access to local and US stocks, professionally managed funds, and AI-enabled portfolio management for lifestyle investors. The company also produces financial content for social media platforms. For advanced traders, Thndr offers ThndrX, an institutional-grade trading platform with advanced charts, data, custom screeners, and research coverage. 114d242b371e7475.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة درع المدينة للمقاولات عن مدرب لياقة بدنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ برامج تدريب اللياقة البدنية، وتقديم الدعم للمتدربين لتحقيق أهدافهم. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى مدرب اللياقة البدنية مسؤولية وضع الأهداف والخطط والاستراتيجيات التدريبية، وتحديد مؤشرات قياس الأداء، بالإضافة إلى توفير الموارد والتقنيات اللازمة لتدريبات اللياقة البدنية. كما يقوم بإجراء التدريبات وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الأهداف والخطط التشغيلية واستراتيجيات التدريب، وتحديد الأهداف الرئيسية والقيم المستهدفة ومؤشراتها، ومتابعة قياسها باستمرار. تحديد وتوفير جميع الموارد والمواد والتقنيات اللازمة للتدريب على اللياقة البدنية، وضمان الاستخدام الأمثل لها. إجراء تدريبات اللياقة البدنية وفقاً للخطط والأهداف الموضوعة، وتنمية السمات والقدرات التربوية والنفسية الإيجابية لدى المتدربين بصورة متكاملة ومتوازنة. قياس وتقييم التقدم في مجال اللياقة البدنية، وتطوير برامج التدريب بناءً على النتائج المحققة. تقديم الدعم والمساندة اللازمة للمتدربين لتمكينهم من رفع قدراتهم وتحقيق أهدافهم، ونقل المعلومات والمعارف لهم، والرد على استفساراتهم وأسئلتهم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تدريب اللياقة البدنية. القدرة على وضع خطط تدريبية فعالة ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم والإرشاد للمتدربين. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المرشح ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تركز على تحقيق أهداف اللياقة البدنية للمتدربين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

115658b4de42f63b.description: About Spring Health Spring Health is a leading provider of comprehensive mental health benefits for employers, focused on removing barriers to mental health care. The company's clinically validated solution integrates technology with a network of vetted providers to improve employee engagement, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. Spring Health helps employees understand their mental health needs and connects them with appropriate treatment. The Opportunity Spring Health is seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed Psychotherapists or Psychologists with a specialization in minor care to join its provider network in Saudi Arabia. This contract role involves delivering care through a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform designed to prioritize patient outcomes. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Provide counseling to clients under various benefit structures, ranging from short-term, goal-focused EAP to employer health plans allowing medically necessary sessions. Treat adult clients who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings to identify symptoms and areas of concern. Maintain a calendar to display availability and complete session documentation promptly within the scheduling system. Utilize evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions tailored to client needs. Collaborate with dedicated provider support, licensed clinical care navigation, and administrative care support teams as needed. Deliver culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding values of diversity and inclusion. Required Qualifications and Experience Proper qualification and licensure to practice counseling (as a Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, Social Worker, etc.) in Saudi Arabia. Applicants requiring licensed supervision cannot be accepted. Active professional liability insurance at market rates in the approved jurisdiction (country of licensure). Qualification and previous experience treating minors (age 10 and below). A minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience. Access to a computer or laptop, comfort with technology, and tele-health competency. Training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, and CPT. Comfortable providing safety planning and intervention in situations where a client may present with higher risks. Commitment to quality clinical care and a desire to expand capabilities and effectiveness through client progress and challenge insights. Openness to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families is preferred. Work Environment and Benefits This role offers the flexibility to set your own schedule to align with professional and personal needs. Work can be conducted from any confidential, private location with stable internet access. Spring Health manages administrative tasks such as marketing, insurance eligibility checks, fee collection, and claims submission, allowing providers to focus on clinical care. Providers will also benefit from feedback derived from evidence-based measures to enhance care effectiveness and will join a supportive community with opportunities for connection and collaboration with other providers and clinical care navigators.

11650a7b51c45d7b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تطوير الخرائط لتقنية نظم المعلومات عن مطور تطبيقات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم وتطوير وصيانة حلول التطبيقات لتلبية متطلبات العملاء. وهو منصب بدوام كامل يتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف مطور التطبيقات إلى تقديم حلول برمجية متكاملة، بدءًا من فهم متطلبات التصميم وحتى نشر التطبيقات واختبارها وصيانتها. يتضمن ذلك العمل على دورة حياة تطوير التطبيقات بأكملها لضمان تقديم منتجات عالية الجودة تلبي احتياجات العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فهم خطط تصميم التطبيقات وإعداد خطط مفصلة لكتابة الأكواد البرمجية واختبارها، مع تحديد الأطر الزمنية ومراحل التنفيذ. تطوير الأكواد البرمجية للتطبيقات باستخدام لغات البرمجة المناسبة وتجميعها في برامج تنفيذية جاهزة للاستخدام. نشر التطبيقات على أجهزة العملاء وتنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الاختبارات اللازمة والتشغيل التجريبي للمنتج لضمان فعاليته. توثيق جميع إجراءات تطوير التطبيقات بشكل دقيق لتسهيل التحديثات والتغييرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال تطوير التطبيقات. القدرة على فهم خطط تصميم التطبيقات وتحويلها إلى أكواد برمجية. معرفة بلغات البرمجة المستخدمة في تطوير التطبيقات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المطور ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة تطوير الخرائط لتقنية نظم المعلومات، مع التركيز على تقديم حلول تقنية مبتكرة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

1197bc39f9f9b04c.description: Job description About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. Position Overview: The Payroll Specialist is responsible for managing end-to-end payroll operations across Saudi Arabia and the UAE, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing. The role serves as the primary liaison between HR, Finance, employees, the U.S. Payroll team, and the third-party payroll support provider, while also supporting the transition to a new integrated payroll system. Collect, validate, and consolidate payroll inputs, including new hires, terminations, attendance, salary changes, allowances, deductions, and employee data updates. Maintain payroll records, support internal and external audits, and identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, controls, efficiency, and accuracy. Support the implementation and rollout of the new payroll system across the Middle East region, including requirements gathering, testing, data validation, issue resolution, and post-go-live stabilization. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 1–2 years of hands-on payroll processing experience, specifically managing Saudi Arabia and/or UAE payroll (multi-country GCC payroll experience preferred). Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. 110854401c438d26.description: About NEOM Green Hydrogen Company NEOM Green Hydrogen Company Limited (NGHC) is developing the world's largest plant for green ammonia production in Neom, Tabuk. This initiative supports Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 by aiming for a carbon-free future. The plant will integrate up to 4GW of onshore solar and wind energy to produce up to 650 tons of green ammonia daily for global transportation, with operations scheduled to commence in 2026. NGHC is a joint venture between ACWA Power, Air Products, and NEOM. Report schedule compliance and KPI parameters effectively. Report the status of external jobs and act as the primary contact for contractors. Comply with NGHC Safety Standards and the contractors’ management system. Optimize and utilize manpower efficiently. Lead daily Operation and Maintenance coordination meetings and contractor kick-off meetings. Interface with NGHC-MM, prioritize tasks, and provide visibility on material orders on hold. Provide on-call support for plant emergencies to plan emergency maintenance activities. Ensure inventory control and balance for all instrument spare parts. Principal Duties Develop detailed maintenance schedules using software such as SAP S/4Hana, MS Project, or other planning tools. Define work breakdown structures (WBS) and sequence activities for efficiency. Establish and maintain baseline schedules. Identify and allocate manpower, equipment, tooling, spares, and materials according to project needs. Ensure optimal utilization of instrument resources to enhance productivity. Track and monitor the progress of electrical works against the schedule. Generate weekly and monthly progress reports for NGHC management. Identify delays, analyze root causes, and recommend corrective actions. Ensure smooth coordination between different electrical activities and other disciplines. Identify potential project risks (delays, resource shortages, design changes) and develop mitigation strategies. Revise schedules as needed to accommodate unforeseen changes. Monitor subcontractor performance to ensure adherence to job timelines. Support in Turnaround/Shutdown (TA/SD) job package preparation. Prepare reports based on KPIs. Demonstrated ability to manage and optimize resources. The specialist will ensure effective procurement, management, and distribution to support operational needs, contributing to the operational readiness and success of aviation activities. Role Overview This multifaceted position involves strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with expertise in document management and aviation supply logistics. The Aviation Supply Specialist will collaborate with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to maintain accurate inventory records, facilitate timely deliveries, and ensure compliance with safety and quality standards. The role also includes analyzing supply data and utilizing ERP systems to optimize supply chain operations. Key Responsibilities Initiate, process, and track material requisitions for aviation supplies and equipment to ensure timely fulfillment of operational needs. Maintain accurate inventory records, including stock levels, locations, and status, for efficient inventory control and replenishment. Facilitate transportation and logistics support for incoming and outgoing shipments, ensuring timely delivery and compliance with policies. Communicate with the procurement section to obtain quotes, place orders, track deliveries, and resolve any discrepancies. Inspect incoming supplies for quality and accuracy, ensuring compliance with specifications and standards. Utilize ERP systems such as SAP, G21, RAMCO, or similar platforms for supply chain operations. Maintain documentation related to supply transactions, including purchase orders, receipts, and invoices. Analyze supply data, including usage trends and inventory levels, to identify optimization and cost-saving opportunities. Provide responsive customer service to internal customers, addressing inquiries and resolving issues. Ensure compliance with aviation supply chain regulations, policies, and procedures, including safety and security protocols. Identify and implement process improvements and efficiency gains in aviation supply chain operations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including maintenance, operations, and procurement, to align supply chain activities with organizational goals. Participate in training programs to enhance knowledge and skills in aviation supply chain management. Function as the Assistant Lead Aviation Supply Specialist. Attendance and presentations at meetings and conferences may be required. Qualifications and Experience 4 years of experience in material requisition, inventory management, or logistics coordination, preferably within an aviation context. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment supporting critical aviation operations. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to the efficient management of aviation supplies and equipment.

114fc17465feb499.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking an EHS Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires an ARAMCO-approved professional with a strong background in Oil and Gas experience. The EHS Supervisor will be responsible for overseeing and implementing all Environmental, Health, and Safety protocols across assigned project zones, ensuring compliance with industry standards and company policies. Key Responsibilities Prepare all EHS-related documents, including EHS plans, emergency response plans, and risk assessments. Attend EHS meetings with clients and project teams, reporting all EHS issues to the Head Office. Provide EHS induction training to new workers and conduct daily EHS inspections for assigned zones. Ensure appropriate safe work permits are obtained by Engineers/Supervisors from Clients/Main Contractors. Conduct site-wide risk assessments, informing Site Engineers and/or Clients/Main Contractors of high-risk areas. Ensure weekly toolbox talks are delivered by Engineers to promote EHS awareness among workers. Verify that all personnel wear required personal protective equipment (helmet, EHS shoes, coveralls). Inspect equipment such as ladders and scaffolding to ensure good working conditions before use. Maintain satisfactory health and hygiene conditions for workers, including water availability, rest areas, and adequate lighting and ventilation. Ensure proper housekeeping on project sites to prevent incidents and accidents. Conduct Job EHS Analysis on high-risk activities to minimize hazardous conditions. Encourage workers and engineers to implement EHS practices and conduct investigations for minor or major incidents/accidents. Communicate investigation results to workers and engineers for future precautions. Administer first-aid or seek medical assistance in case of worker injury. Maintain all documentation related to EHS activities. System Management and Compliance Establish, monitor, appraise, and coordinate upgraded versions of integrated health, safety, and environment management systems (conforming to ISO-45001:2018, ISO14001:2015, and ISO 9001 standards) for construction projects. Improvise procedure manuals and internal audits based on these standards. Conduct training programs on EHS topics for engineers and workers on-site and in HR-organized EHS training programs. Perform hazard identification and risk assessment for critical activities, ensuring method statements incorporate findings. Prepare EHS Plans and Environment Management Plans. Coordinate external EHS audits and third-party inspections of equipment. Prepare Emergency Preparedness Plans and conduct emergency drills. Facilitate the implementation of the Work Permit System. Coordinate occupational health and welfare measures. Prepare EHS conditions of contract for sub-contractors. Safety Enforcement and Reporting Stop work immediately if unsafe practices are witnessed, promoting a "don't walk by" attitude and commitment to action. Carry out monthly project Risk Management Audits and quarterly system audits. Provide EHS reports to the project head and IC Head to inform them of the current status of EHS performance. Qualifications and Experience ARAMCO-approved EHS Supervisor certification is mandatory. Proven experience in the Oil and Gas sector. 5-10 years of relevant experience in an EHS role. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires active presence on project sites to ensure continuous EHS compliance and oversight.

11a4f0016b419e88.description: Company Overview Sirar by stc is an advanced technology and cybersecurity company established by stc, a leading ICT and digital services provider in the region. Analyze incoming requests for potential risks and identified malicious activity to determine weaknesses, exploitation methods, and effects on systems. Conduct regular security reviews and assessments. Support the change management process by documenting and executing system changes, coordinating with appropriate teams to minimize disruption. Facilitate the handover of new systems and services, ensuring smooth transitions and knowledge transfer. Maintain detailed records of ticket statuses and vendor communications for troubleshooting and future reference. Document lessons learned from events and exercises, and facilitate the sharing of best practices and recommendations within cyber operations.
